description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for managing prescriptions in a healthcare blockchain platform. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, and verifying prescriptions, with access control based on user roles and integration with backend services.

methods.name: PrescriptionOut create_new_prescription( payload: PrescriptionCreate, request: Request, db=Depends(get_db), user: dict = Depends(require_roles("doctor")), )
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new prescription, requiring 'doctor' role, and calls backend service to save prescription details.

methods.name: PrescriptionListResponse list_my_prescriptions(db=Depends(get_db), user: dict = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to list prescriptions for the current user, based on user roles.

methods.name: PrescriptionOut get_prescription( prescription_id: str, db=Depends(get_db), user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a specific prescription by ID, with access control based on roles and ownership.

methods.name: PrescriptionOut verify( prescription_id: str, payload: VerifyRequest, request: Request, db=Depends(get_db), user: dict = Depends(require_roles("pharmacist")), )
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests for pharmacists to verify a prescription, updating its status accordingly.

ctags.name: create_new_prescription
ctags.signature: ( payload: PrescriptionCreate, request: Request, db=Depends(get_db), user: dict = Depends(require_roles("doctor")), )

ctags.name: get_prescription
ctags.signature: ( prescription_id: str, db=Depends(get_db), user: dict = Depends(get_current_user) )

ctags.signature: ( prescription_id: str, payload: VerifyRequest, request: Request, db=Depends(get_db), user: dict = Depends(require_roles("pharmacist")), )
